description: This file defines a wizard for tracking and splitting stock moves in an Odoo (OpenERP) module related to manufacturing resource planning (MRP). It includes form definitions, validation, and logic for creating production lots and updating stock move records.

classes.name: wizard_track_move
classes.description: A wizard interface for tracking and splitting stock moves, including validation and update logic.

methods.name: _check_picking
methods.description: Validates that the stock move or its production order has an associated picking before splitting.

methods.name: _track_lines
methods.description: Creates new production lots, updates stock moves with quantities and serial numbers, and links them to production orders.
